import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

dfs = []
for f in sorted(glob.glob('data/raman/*.csv')):
    df_file = pd.read_csv(f)
    x_col = df_file.columns[0]
    y_col = df_file.columns[1]
    
    # Peak heights (no baseline correction)
    mask_d = (df_file[x_col] >= 1300) & (df_file[x_col] <= 1400)
    mask_g = (df_file[x_col] >= 1550) & (df_file[x_col] <= 1620)
    
    i_d = df_file.loc[mask_d, y_col].max()
    i_g = df_file.loc[mask_g, y_col].max()
    
    ratio = i_g / i_d if i_d != 0 else 0
    name = f.split('/')[-1].replace('.csv', '')
    
    dfs.append({'name': name, 'ratio': ratio})

df = pd.DataFrame(dfs)
